summary: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines, enabling rapid development of secure, maintainable web applications with Python.
usecases: Building scalable web applications and APIs with ORM and template engine.
Rapid prototyping of content management systems and SaaS platforms.
Developing enterprise-grade web solutions with authentication and admin interface.
ideas: Integrating Django with modern frontend frameworks like HTMX or Svelte for lightweight apps.
Building a micro-SaaS boilerplate with multi-tenant architecture.
Using Django's ORM for data-intensive dashboards and reporting tools.
